name: @pipeworx/mcp-indonesia-law

tools.name: idn_search_regulations
tools.description: Search Indonesia's national register of laws and regulations (Undang-Undang statutes, Perpu, Peraturan Pemerintah, Peraturan Presiden, Keppres, Inpres) by Indonesian title words, instrument type and year. Returns each instrument's citation, title, legal status (in force / partially amended / revoked), enactment and promulgation dates and a link to the signed PDF, from the State Secretariat JDIH (jdih.setneg.go.id). Use for "what Indonesian laws exist about X", "list Indonesian statutes passed in 2023", "is UU 11/2020 Cipta Kerja still in force".

query.description: Indonesian words expected in the instrument's title, e.g. "cipta kerja", "pajak", "kesehatan", "mahkamah konstitusi". Optional; leave empty to list by type and year.

type.description: Instrument type or comma-separated types: UU, PERPU, PP, PERPRES, KEPPRES, INPRES, PERMENSESNEG, KEPMENSESNEG. Optional.

year.description: Four-digit year or comma-separated years, e.g. "2023" or "2021,2022". Optional.

status.description: Legal-status filter as the register spells it: "berlaku" (in force), "sebagian" (partially amended/revoked), "tidak berlaku" (no longer in force). Optional.

tools.name: idn_regulation_detail
tools.description: Full register record for one Indonesian law or regulation by type, number and year: title, legal status, state gazette (Lembaran Negara / Tambahan) numbers, dates, the signed PDF, and its relations — which instruments amend or revoke it, which it amends or revokes, related implementing regulations and any judicial-review entry — from the State Secretariat JDIH (jdih.setneg.go.id). Use for "details of UU 6/2023", "what amended PP 5/2021", "get the PDF of Perpres 40/2026".

type.description: Instrument type: UU, PERPU, PP, PERPRES, KEPPRES, INPRES, PERMENSESNEG or KEPMENSESNEG.

tools.name: idn_regulation_article_text
tools.description: Text of one PASAL (article) of an Indonesian law or regulation, extracted from the signed PDF on file at the State Secretariat JDIH (jdih.setneg.go.id) — the same official document idn_regulation_detail links to. Use for "what does Pasal 1 of UU 13/2003 say", "text of Article 27 of the Ketenagakerjaan law", "read Pasal 28D of the Constitution's implementing statute". Returns the article's own text bounded by the next article heading; if the PDF cannot be read as text, or the article is not found, the response says so explicitly rather than returning an empty string.

type.description: Instrument type: UU, PERPU, PP, PERPRES, KEPPRES, INPRES, PERMENSESNEG or KEPMENSESNEG.

pasal.description: Article number as the statute numbers it, e.g. "1" or "28D" for Pasal 28D. "Pasal 1" also accepted.

tools.name: idn_list_statutes
tools.description: List Indonesian statutes and executive instruments by type and year from the House of Representatives (DPR RI) legal register — Undang-Undang, Perpu, Peraturan Pemerintah, Peraturan Presiden, Keputusan Presiden, Instruksi Presiden, Peraturan DPR — with the DPR id needed by idn_statute_detail and a direct PDF link, optionally filtered by Indonesian title words. Use for "all Indonesian laws enacted in 2020", "presidential regulations of 2024 about energy".

type.description: One of: uu, perpu, pp, perpres, keppres, inpres, perdpr, peraturanbersama (default uu).

year.description: Four-digit year, e.g. "2020". Strongly recommended — without it DPR shows only its newest few.

query.description: Indonesian words that must all appear in the title, e.g. "mineral batubara". Optional.

tools.name: idn_statute_detail
tools.description: Detailed record of one Indonesian statute or executive instrument from the House of Representatives (DPR RI) register: number, year, enactment/promulgation dates, an Indonesian abstract with drafting notes, the responsible DPR commission, the Status list (which earlier laws it amends or revokes, which later laws amend it, and which ARTICLES the Constitutional Court / Mahkamah Konstitusi struck down, with case numbers), the table of implementing regulations per article, and the PDF. Use for "which articles of UU 13/2003 were annulled by the Constitutional Court", "implementing regulations of the Cipta Kerja law", "abstract of UU 1/2026".

type.description: One of: uu, perpu, pp, perpres, keppres, inpres, perdpr (default uu).

dpr_id.description: DPR register id from idn_list_statutes, e.g. "1771" (UU 11/2020 Cipta Kerja) or "196" (UU 13/2003 Ketenagakerjaan).

tools.name: idn_mk_review_search
tools.description: Find Indonesian Constitutional Court (Mahkamah Konstitusi, MK) judicial-review outcomes on statutes — petitions granted (article declared unconstitutional), rejected or inadmissible, plus DPR's post-ruling analyses and its statements in the case — by case number (e.g. 91/PUU-XVIII/2020), by Indonesian statute words, or by year, from the DPR RI "Info Judicial Review" resume collection (800+ documents). Returns the case number, the statute under review, the outcome category and a link for idn_mk_review_detail. Use for "Constitutional Court rulings on the election law", "was the petition against UU 11/2020 granted", "MK decisions in 2023".

query.description: Case number like "21/PUU-XXI/2023", or Indonesian words from the statute title, e.g. "pemilihan umum", "ketenagakerjaan", "nomor 13 tahun 2003". Optional.

category.description: all (default), granted, rejected, analysis, dpr_statement — or a comma-separated subset.

year.description: Four-digit year of the ruling/publication, e.g. "2023". Optional.

tools.name: idn_mk_review_detail
tools.description: Metadata and PDF for one Indonesian Constitutional Court judicial-review resume or DPR analysis document from the DPR RI register, given the url returned by idn_mk_review_search: full title, document kind, MK case number, statute under review, publication year and the resume PDF from berkas.dpr.go.id. Use after idn_mk_review_search to read the ruling summary.

url.description: A jdih.dpr.go.id/setjen/view/... url from idn_mk_review_search (the slug after /setjen/view/ also works).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-indonesia-law forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the indonesia-law pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
